name: Triangle World Elite Mastercard

apr.notes: Outside Quebec 21.99% on all charges excluding cash transactions and 22.99% on cash transactions and related fees; Quebec residents 21.99% on all charges.

credit_required.notes: Minimum $80,000 annual income or $150,000 household income. Applications currently accepted online only.

base_rate.description: 1% in CT Money everywhere else you shop.

categories.label: Canadian Tire, Sport Chek, Mark’s, L’Équipeur, Party City, Pro Hockey Life, Atmosphere, Sports Rousseau, Hockey Experts, L’Entrepôt du Hockey and participating Sports Experts stores (pre-tax)
Grocery stores, excluding Walmart, Walmart Superstore and Costco (then 1%)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem your CT Money in-store at Canadian Tire, Sport Chek, Mark’s, L’Équipeur, Party City, Pro Hockey Life, Atmosphere, Sports Rousseau, Hockey Experts, L’Entrepôt du Hockey, and participating Sports Experts stores.

notes: Also earns 7 cents per litre in CT Money on premium fuel and 5 cents per litre on other fuel at Gas+ and Petro-Canada locations. Includes the Roadside Assistance Gold Plan (activation required) and car rental collision/loss damage waiver insurance. Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name.
